full_judgment:
6. Mr. Gorib Newaz, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners has placed the Revisional Application, pleadings, evidence, exhibits, impugned judgment and decree of the Courts below and other materials on record before this court and submits that both the Courts below failed to consider the evidence both oral and documentary of the plaintiff and thereby committed illegality in passing the impugned judgment and decree. He further submits that both the Court below erred in law in non-consideration of evidence and misreading of the evidence and thereby the trial Court dismissed the suit and appellate Court on misconception of law and non-consideration of materials on record dismissed the appeal by affirming the judgment and decree of the trial Court. He next submits that the R.S. Khatian number and Plot number are not identical to the suit land which is published in the gazette notification. He lastly submits that the Vested Property Case numbers which were produced by the defendants those were started after 1975 which is not sustainable in law. 

 10. Khatian No. 353/2 and S.A. Khatian No. 229 and CS. Plot No. 542 and other plot numbers were appeared.
